$comment: POSSIBILITY SPACE domain Revenue (internal-docs §Candidate Generation). Pengetahuan domain mendeklarasikan RUANG kemungkinan: strategi apa yang didukung, kapan sebuah strategi menjadi KANDIDAT (emerges_when — predikat tri-state atas sinyal keadaan terverifikasi, mekanisme, rule aktif), kapan tidak berlaku (not_applicable_when), dan check yang menentukan feasibility. BUKAN daftar path: sebuah strategi hanya melahirkan Possible Path bila keadaan user mendukungnya; jumlah path 0..N. Identitas strategi & motion dibaca dari ontology/route/strategies.json (motion = Revenue Motion Primitive, label domain, BUKAN identitas path); substrat route dari ontology/route/templates. Validator: ontology/possibility/validate_possibility.py.

strategies.title: Winning new clients
strategies.basis: dapat klien baru lewat kanal yang cocok dengan calon klien ideal Anda

en.basis: Win new clients through a channel that fits your ideal client.

checks.title: kapasitas masih tersedia
checks.unlock: ukur jam delivery → turunkan beban atau tambah kapasitas (subkon) sampai tersisa ruang kerja yang cukup

en.title: You still have room in your week
en.unlock: Measure your delivery hours, then cut the load or add capacity (subcontract) until you have enough room.

checks.title: demand ada (inquiry/lead masuk)
checks.unlock: jalankan percobaan akuisisi kecil (outbound/manual) untuk membuktikan lead masuk

en.title: Demand exists (inquiries or leads come in)
en.unlock: Run a small manual outreach test to prove that leads come in.

strategies.title: Repricing your offer
strategies.basis: naikkan harga/penataan arsitektur harga pada demand eksisting

en.basis: Raise or restructure your prices on the demand you already have.

checks.title: willingness-to-pay terbukti di harga baru
checks.unlock: bukti kesediaan membayar harga baru yang diusulkan: komitmen uang nyata dari pembeli pada harga baru

en.title: A buyer is proven to pay your new price
en.unlock: Show that a buyer commits real money at the new price you propose.

checks.title: bukti permintaan melebihi kapasitas
checks.unlock: ukur jam kerja / kumpulkan inquiry yang berlebih sebagai bukti permintaan melebihi kapasitas

en.title: Demand is proven to be more than you can serve
en.unlock: Measure your working hours and collect the overflow inquiries as proof that demand is more than you can serve.

strategies.title: Growing current clients
strategies.basis: perluas nilai klien aktif (upsell/lingkup baru di basis yang sama)

en.basis: Grow what your current clients are worth with upsells or new scope.

checks.title: klien aktif terukur (nilai deal + pendapatan berjalan)
checks.unlock: ukur nilai klien aktif (rata-rata nilai deal + pendapatan berjalan) dari bukti transaksi

en.title: Active clients are measured (deal value and current income)
en.unlock: Measure the value of your active clients (average deal and current income) from real transactions.

checks.title: willingness-to-pay terbukti di harga sekarang
checks.unlock: bukti kesediaan membayar: klien bayar penuh di harga sekarang dan bertahan (retensi terukur)

en.title: Clients are proven to pay your current price
en.unlock: Show that clients pay full price today and stay (measured retention).

strategies.title: Partners and referrals
strategies.basis: pakai jalur distribusi pihak lain (referral, affiliate, aliansi, channel)

en.basis: Use other people's channels: referrals, affiliates, alliances.

checks.title: klien aktif terukur (nilai deal + pendapatan berjalan)
checks.unlock: ukur nilai klien aktif dari bukti transaksi, sebagai bahan penawaran kemitraan

en.title: Active clients are measured (deal value and current income)
en.unlock: Measure the value of your active clients from real transactions, as material for a partner offer.

checks.title: bukti referral/jaringan menghasilkan lead
checks.unlock: catat minimal 1 lead yang datang dari referral/jaringan Anda

en.title: Referrals or your network are proven to bring leads
en.unlock: Record at least 1 lead that came from a referral or your network.

checks.title: kapasitas tersedia untuk permintaan kemitraan
checks.unlock: ukur jam delivery → pastikan ada ruang kapasitas sebelum komit partner

en.title: You have room for partner demand
en.unlock: Measure your delivery hours and make sure you have room before you commit to a partner.

en.basis: Buy demand through ads (Meta, Google, LinkedIn).

checks.title: baseline konversi terukur (inquiry → closing)
checks.unlock: ukur konversi funnel eksisting (n inquiry → n closing, ≥1 siklus)

en.title: Conversion is measured (inquiry to closed deal)
en.unlock: Measure your current funnel (inquiries to closed deals, at least one cycle).

checks.title: baseline CAC terukur
checks.unlock: jalankan budget uji kecil dan catat spend per lead/customer

en.title: Cost per client is measured
en.unlock: Run a small test budget and record the spend per lead or customer.

checks.title: ekonomi viable (unit economics positif)
checks.unlock: hitung unit economics dari CAC + nilai klien terukur

en.title: The economics work (positive unit economics)
en.unlock: Work out unit economics from the measured cost per client and client value.

patterns.title: Fixing how you respond to leads
patterns.thesis: lead yang sudah masuk bocor di proses respons dan follow-up — menambah lead baru hanya memperbesar kebocoran
patterns.basis: perbaiki respons dan follow-up atas lead yang sudah masuk sebelum menambah volume

en.basis: Tighten how you answer and follow up on the leads you already have before you add more.
en.because: Leads are reaching you, but some slip away in how they are answered and followed up.

patterns.title: Narrowing who you reach
patterns.thesis: kontak yang dijangkau tidak cocok dengan pembeli yang memutuskan — menambah volume memperbanyak kontak yang salah
patterns.basis: pilih siapa pembeli yang memutuskan sebelum menambah volume jangkauan

en.basis: Decide who actually makes the buying decision before you reach out to more people.
en.because: Some of the people you reach are not the ones who decide to buy.

patterns.title: Shaping an offer people can buy
patterns.thesis: kemampuan ada tetapi belum dibentuk menjadi penawaran yang bisa dibeli — kanal baru tidak menolong penawaran yang belum terbentuk
patterns.basis: bentuk kemampuan menjadi satu penawaran tertulis yang bisa dibeli

en.basis: Turn what you can do into one written offer that someone can say yes to.
en.because: You can do the work, but it is not yet shaped into something a person can buy.
